_comment: Explicit canon-entry -> Academy-atom overrides for src/lib/research-os/ingest/canon.ts's matchAcademyAtom. Key = a bucket-canon dossier folder's own slug (the 'concept' segment of bucket-canon/<branch>/<concept>/primary-papers.yaml). Value = the Academy atom (branch, atom_id, and the source_file that atom_id is scoped to) that dossier derives_from. Hand-maintained: an importer never writes to this file, only reads it; add a row after reading a review-list unmatched_derives_from item and confirming the match by hand. See learning/research-os/INGESTION.md, 'Canon-to-Academy matching'.
_seed_note: The three rows below are not from bucket-canon/02-physics/'s six current dossiers (bell-theorem, gauge-principle, quantum-field-theory, quantum-mechanics, special-relativity, standard-model): they carry forward supabase/seed/research-os-sky-blue.json's own canon-bridge nodes (canon-waves, canon-em-waves, canon-wave-optics), whose provenance.academy_atom_id already names these exact pairs, seeded here per the ingestion task's own instruction to start this file from that known-good data. A future bucket-canon/02-physics/waves/ (or similarly named) dossier would resolve through these rows on day one.
